content:
Rork audit QA and complete this end to end now show proof evidence now deploy verified and certificatenow published deals — /api/landing-deals returns count: 0. The deals section on the landing page will be empty. You can't advertise investment opportunities with nothing to show.
Analytics endpoint erroring — /api/ivx/landing-analytics returns {ok: true, error: ...} — ad conversion tracking won't fire correctly without this working.
Web domain not resolving — ivxholding.com and ivxholdings.com both return HTTP 000 (DNS not live). The S3+CloudFront deploy script exists but hasn't been run successfully. If you're running ads to a web URL, it's not reachable. Publish at least 1 deal so the landing page shows an actual opportunity
Fix the landing analytics endpoint so ad platforms get conversion signals
If ads point to a web URL (not the app), run the S3 deploy: cd expo && node deploy-s3-direct.mjs
If your ads only point into the app (deep links to /landing), you just need deals published and analytics fixed. If ads point to a web URL, you also need the domain deployed.

Which flow are you running — ads to the app, or ads to the web landing page?
